# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas practice for local small businesses. The entry point is a free one-page online checkup: where a shop ranks on Google Maps against the three businesses nearest it, whether AI assistants like ChatGPT recommend that shop or a competitor, and the three issues costing it customers. Nothing about the checkup requires the owner's password. Paid work follows only if the owner wants the problems fixed: a done-for-you AI customer service and booking system (website included) that answers customers and books appointments 24/7, $2,000 one-time, then $200/month. Jack also runs community AI workshops in Dallas–Fort Worth. Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142 (text CHECKUP with a shop name to start). Service area: Dallas, Richardson, Plano, Garland, Allen (Texas, USA).

Key facts:

- Google Business Profile: live and reviewed by real customers — https://g.page/r/CWX_rCfFduC1EAI
- Founder: Jack Qian, Business Planner at Texas Instruments and Dallas AI educator. Has run a 70-person multi-agent AI workshop (May 2026) and a 37-person AI hackathon (April 2026) in the Dallas area.
- Free online checkup: a one-page report covering Google Maps position versus the three nearest competitors, whether ChatGPT and other AI assistants name the business, and three specific issues with a number attached to each. Free, no password or account access needed, delivered within about two days. Started by texting CHECKUP plus the shop name to (469) 425-4142.
- AI Customer Service + Booking System: a done-for-you AI that answers customers and books appointments 24/7 for Dallas appointment businesses (salons, barbershops, nails, med-spa, dental, auto). $2,000 one-time build, then $200/month to keep it running. Jack builds it, installs it, and runs it; a booking-first website and a tuned Google Business Profile are included, live within a week.
- AI education: free community talks, workshops, and build events. Paid offering: "AI for Beginner" — a live class taught in person in Dallas and online. No coding required.

- [Free Online Checkup](https://aimanjack.com/#pricing): the entry point — one free page showing Google Maps position, AI-assistant visibility, and the three issues costing the business customers
